Fix common problems in GTFS feeds

Source: R/fix_gtfs.R
fix_gtfs.Rd

Cleans a GTFS feed in one call, by removing duplicated entries and unused ids, optionally capping the speed of trips, and filling blank stop times.

Usage

fix_gtfs(gtfs, max_speed = NULL, unit = "km/h")

Arguments

gtfs

A GTFS object, as created by read_gtfs().

max_speed

A number. The maximum speed of trips, in the unit given by unit. If NULL (the default), speeds are not capped.

unit

A string representing the unit in which max_speed is given. One of "km/h" (the default), "m/s" or "mph" (miles per hour).

Value

The fixed GTFS object.

Details

The feed goes through the following steps, in this order:

  1. remove_duplicates() removes duplicated entries from every table;

  2. remove_unused_ids() removes the trips without stop_times, and the entries of every table that no remaining trip uses (see its documentation for the exceptions). Note that this removes data from the feed;

  3. set_max_speed(), only if max_speed is given, slows down the parts of trips that are faster than max_speed. Only spans between stops with known times are capped, and spans that end before they start (e.g. times after midnight written as "00:30:00") are left unchanged, with a warning;

  4. interpolate_stop_times() fills blank stop times from the times of the stops around them. Speeds are capped before interpolating, so the filled times follow the capped times. Interpolated times are rounded to the second. Stops whose times can't be interpolated are left blank, with a warning.

The trips and stop_times tables are always required, and stops is required to cap speeds and to fill blank times. The warnings raised are those of the functions above, so some warnings (e.g. about a missing shapes table) may be raised twice.

See also

remove_duplicates(), remove_unused_ids(), set_max_speed(), interpolate_stop_times()

Examples

library(dplyr)

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo_gtfs.zip", package = "gtfstools")

gtfs <- read_gtfs(data_path)

fixed_gtfs <- fix_gtfs(gtfs, max_speed = 40)

# duplicated agencies were removed, and the trip is now slower
gtfs$agency
#>    agency_id agency_name                               agency_url
#>       <char>      <char>                                   <char>
#> 1:         1     SPTRANS http://www.sptrans.com.br/?versao=011019
#> 2:         1     SPTRANS http://www.sptrans.com.br/?versao=011019
#>      agency_timezone agency_lang
#>               <char>      <char>
#> 1: America/Sao_Paulo          pt
#> 2: America/Sao_Paulo          pt
fixed_gtfs$agency
#>    agency_id agency_name                               agency_url
#>       <char>      <char>                                   <char>
#> 1:         1     SPTRANS http://www.sptrans.com.br/?versao=011019
#>      agency_timezone agency_lang
#>               <char>      <char>
#> 1: America/Sao_Paulo          pt

gtfs$stop_times |>
  filter(trip_id == "CPTM L07-0") |>
  slice_tail(n = 1)
#>       trip_id arrival_time departure_time stop_id stop_sequence
#>        <char>       <char>         <char>  <char>         <int>
#> 1: CPTM L07-0     06:16:00       06:16:00   18975            18

fixed_gtfs$stop_times |>
  filter(trip_id == "CPTM L07-0") |>
  slice_tail(n = 1)
#>       trip_id arrival_time departure_time stop_id stop_sequence
#>        <char>       <char>         <char>  <char>         <int>
#> 1: CPTM L07-0     06:19:33       06:19:33   18975            18
